elderly, will need to use a ﬁ ber supplement if they are unable
to consume adequate ﬁ ber from foods. Products that may be 
used to normalize GI function include Fiberall® and Metamu-
cil®, bulk-forming agents made from psyllium, a source of 
insoluble ﬁ ber, and Beneﬁ ber®, soluble dietary ﬁ ber extracted 
from guar gum. Other sources of ﬁ ber supplementation such as
methylcellulose have also been used successfully. Certainly the 
preferred method to increase ﬁ ber intake is through foods, but,
if needed, these supplements are available.
Th e patient with acute diverticulitis will be progressed from 
bowel rest to clear liquids. Th e patient can then move toward a
low-residue diet until inﬂ ammation and bleeding are no longer
